approvers: Developer or main contractor, who set the subcontract package and pay for protection
reason: Protection of glazing is set in the subcontract package by the developer or main contractor, not by me. I am a site manager and cannot start a new budget line and a new supplier on my own. Film and tape cost us next to nothing.
objection: Film and tape cost almost nothing, so why pay about 19 euro per m2 for a coating? It is a new supplier and a new budget line that nobody has asked me for.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape bought locally, and leave glazing protection to whatever the developer's package already specifies.
would_change_my_mind: The developer or main contractor writing it into the specification and paying for it, or proof that it cuts glazing damage claims and snagging by far more than it costs.
